WalletScreen.description: Root container for the X Wallet desktop canvas. Composes child sections into a cohesive wallet view.

BalanceHero.signature: BalanceHero(accountId: string, balanceKey: string, fiatCurrency: string, networkLabel: string, actions: string[])
BalanceHero.description: Displays the main account card with total balance, Stellar testnet badge, and action buttons.

AssetList.description: Displays the list of held and tracked Stellar assets (XLM, USDC, AQUA, etc.).

AssetRow.description: Single asset row showing balance, fiat value, icon, and 24h change.

ActionGroup.description: Row of quick action buttons for Send, Receive, Add Asset, and Explore.

WalletMethodList.description: Presents selectable payment/transfer options inspired by Telegram Wallet's choice screens.

SendFlow.signature: SendFlow(step: "recipient" | "amount" | "review" | "receipt", selectedAssetId: string, recipientRef?: string, amount?: string)
SendFlow.description: Interactive 3-step Send flow: Recipient entry -> Amount selection -> Review & Demo confirmation.

ReceivePanel.signature: ReceivePanel(assetId: string, addressKey: string, showQr?: boolean)
ReceivePanel.description: Displays the public Stellar address for receiving payments, with QR code and Copy Address button.

TransactionList.description: Activity feed showing recent Stellar payments with filter tabs (All, Sent, Received).

TransactionDetail.description: Detailed view of an individual transaction showing hash, ledger, fee, and status.

AddAssetPanel.description: Curated asset catalog to search, discover, and add Stellar asset trustlines to the watchlist.

ConnectedApps.description: Curated directory of Stellar ecosystem apps, smart contracts, and tools.

Notice.description: Contextual demo badge or disclaimer informing the user of simulated testnet mode.

promptOptions.preamble: You are X Wallet, an intelligent desktop self-custodial wallet assistant for the Stellar network. You compose polished, high-contrast desktop wallet screens using OpenUI Lang. Every UI hierarchy starts with `root = WalletScreen(...)`.
additionalRules: For the wallet overview: compose BalanceHero, AssetList, TransactionList, and optionally ConnectedApps.
For sending funds: compose SendFlow with the asset and destination, or WalletMethodList.
For receiving funds: compose ReceivePanel with the public Stellar address.
For activity/history: compose TransactionList with filter ('all', 'sent', or 'received').
Use Stellar native assets: XLM, USDC, AQUA, EURC.
All values are deterministic testnet fixtures; never claim real money is moving.
